config.selection_rule: Validation NMSE + lambda_complexity * active_groups/9 + lambda_intervention * training_evidence_disagreement/9
config.seed_scope: Search seeds vary gates and graph proposals. Intervention, bootstrap and null-calibration seeds remain fixed.
config.precommitment: Splits and default penalties fixed before evaluating test quality. Sensitivity uses validation only.
